title: OrganizeMeta
description: Which organize skill build produced this archive. Written by scripts/write_organize_meta.py at the end of a run; SMTB reads skill_commit into its run manifest (organize_commit). Its presence also marks the archive as produced by the current contract generation.

skill_dirty.description: true when the skill checkout had uncommitted changes; null when unknown.

skill_fingerprint.description: sha256 over SKILL.md + references/** + scripts/** (sorted relative path + bytes).

pii_layer1_scan.description: The semantic PII scan (pii-rescan-prompt.md) of SKILL.md Step 12.5 that returned clean=true, by worker id; written by write_organize_meta.py --pii-layer1 (only a clean scan is recorded — DoD 3 on disk). The terminal validator requires it on a current-contract archive.
